name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and enables Nginx, configures three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, serves static test, CI, and status content, and applies host and web-server security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, runtime directories, configuration workarounds, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, provisions its virtual environment and database, and runs it with Uvicorn under systemd.
